subtitle.zh: Local music understanding with the OpenMOSS 8B Instruct model: timestamped lyrics transcription, genre / mood / instrumentation captions, song structure, key / tempo / chord progressions, and free-form questions about a full track. Local HTTP service (port 8790); audio longer than 5 minutes is sliced into 3-minute segments with 5s overlap and the timestamps are merged. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (INT8 from 16GB, INT4 from 12GB) and at least 60GB free disk.

notes.zh: MTNode starts/stops this local HTTP service (127.0.0.1:8790): /health probes, /load loads the model + quant tier, /unload frees VRAM, /generate returns the answer and writes md / json / srt into the caller-provided outputDir.
